question.text: During halogen test, sodium fusion extract is boiled with concentrated <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>HNO</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> to

options.text: decompose cyanide or sulphide of sodium

solution.text: The sodium fusion extract is first boiled with concentrated nitric acid to decompose cyanide or sulphide of sodium formed during Lassaigne's test. These ions would otherwise interfere with silver nitrate test for halogens.
